title: Manganese oxide-mediated halogenation of carbazole under marine-related conditions
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1299-1308
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00064A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Meng Zhang, Jia Tang, Kunde Lin
This study demonstrates that δ-MnO2, a ubiquitous and highly reactive manganese oxide in marine sediments, can mediate the abiotic halogenation of carbazole under environmentally relevant conditions.
